name: infrachecks-downtimes
title: InfraChecks Downtimes: recurring scheduled downtimes
author: InfraChecks
description: Creates recurring scheduled downtimes (weekly, nth weekday of the month, daily or listed dates) from ~/etc/infrachecks/downtimes.ini. Run bin/infrachecks-downtimes hourly as the site user. Uses Livestatus only; no automation user needed. GPLv2.
